title: Offing migration verification v1
$comment: Deprecated in Offing 0.1.4. Use https://velella.sh/offing/schemas/verify-result.v1.schema.json for new integrations.

receipt.description: What the change since the session's last scan did to the repository's findings. Present when a scan was observed before verification.

receipt_markdown.description: The receipt rendered for a pull request body, with the offing-receipt marker.

verifyResult.description: The verification contract for the same two scans, when it fits the tool answer.

verifyResultUnavailable.description: The full verification document was omitted to preserve its integrity. Use the CLI with the saved before scan.

truncated.description: Always true: the answer was cut to fit the size cap.

hint.description: How to read what was left out.

omitted.description: One entry per array that lost elements. A path with [] sums every array at that position, including those inside elements that were left out.

path.description: Where the array sits, such as findings or findings[].usages.

shown.description: Elements in the answer as returned.

clipped.description: Path of every text that was shortened; it ends with a truncation marker.

estimatedTokens.description: Size of the answer as returned: three characters of JSON text count as one token.
